title: Live Fault Classes Evaluation

fault_classes.mechanism: tc netem adds artificial delay to inter-service traffic (per-destination u32 filter)
fault_classes.expected_rift_behavior: IDENTIFIED — frontend is a non-leaf node with downstream paths to checkout and cart; R3 satisfied
fault_classes.identifiability_state: IDENTIFIABLE (no confounders; directed edges only in oracle PAG)
fault_classes.oracle_result: A_correct_attribution (NL_01, NL_02 both PASS in Phase 3.5 V1 analysis)

fault_classes.mechanism: tc netem adds packet drop percentage to inter-service link
fault_classes.expected_rift_behavior: IDENTIFIED — cart→redis_cart path; cart has downstream diverging service (redis_cart spikes)

fault_classes.mechanism: CPU stress on payment service; degrades processing rate
fault_classes.expected_rift_behavior: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — payment is a leaf node; RIFT currently misattributes to checkout due to R3 leaf-node limitation
fault_classes.identifiability_state: IDENTIFIABLE in principle; MISATTRIBUTED in practice (H_intervention_failure class)
fault_classes.known_limitation: R3 leaf-node failure: payment has no outgoing edges in call-graph PAG

fault_classes.mechanism: Memory pressure on redis_cart; causes cart latency spike via shared resource
fault_classes.expected_rift_behavior: ABSTAINED (confidence=NONE) — redis_cart correctly identified but R3 fails due to cart not independently diverging

fault_classes.mechanism: product_catalog becomes unavailable; recommendation and frontend degrade
fault_classes.expected_rift_behavior: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — same leaf-node R3 issue as SD; product_catalog is a sink
fault_classes.identifiability_state: IDENTIFIABLE in principle; MISATTRIBUTED in practice

fault_classes.mechanism: Overload checkout service; queue depth grows; latency spikes propagate to shipping and payment
fault_classes.expected_rift_behavior: IDENTIFIED — checkout is a non-leaf node (has downstream shipping and payment); R3 satisfied

fault_classes.mechanism: Shared upstream resource causes correlated anomalies in two independent services
fault_classes.expected_rift_behavior: ABSTAINED — bidirected edge detected; identifiability_state=NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; RIFT correctly abstains
fault_classes.oracle_result: B_correct_abstention (all 24 confounded dev scenarios PASS — V2=100%)

fault_classes.mechanism: Two independent faults occur simultaneously or sequentially; both contribute to system degradation
fault_classes.expected_rift_behavior: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — primary root cause (payment) is a leaf node; RIFT misattributes to checkout. Multi-cause attribution requires R4 (intervention data).
fault_classes.identifiability_state: IDENTIFIABLE in principle but requires intervention to disambiguate co-causes

note: Results above are from oracle PAG analysis (Phase 3.5 V1 decomposition). Live testbed results may differ — especially for fault classes where FCI orientation could help leaf-node cases.
